name: Bauernhof Untergrilling
beschreibung: The Bauernhof Untergrilling farm is situated in the municipality of Ebbs in the Tyrolean Unterland. The property combines an authentic working farm with a traditional country inn. The kitchen serves hearty regional specialities prepared in part with ingredients sourced directly from their own agricultural production. Guests can choose from comfortable holiday apartments and welcoming guest rooms. Its location in the Inn Valley provides seamless access to numerous hiking and cycling trails, while excursions to nearby Kufstein or across the border into Germany are within easy reach.
